name: Cafe Sandra
kurzbeschreibung: Café Sandra in Tirol Discover the cozy charm of Café Sandra in the heart of the Tirol Alps.
beschreibung: The Cafe Sandra in Innsbruck offers visitors a heartfelt atmosphere and a fine selection of coffee specialties and homemade treats. Renowned for its sunny terrace that invites relaxation on warm afternoons, the café serves classic Austrian pastries and freshly prepared cakes. Dedicated service makes it an enjoyable neighborhood pause in everyday Tyrolean life.
